participantSessionId.description: DIDComm session identifier of the flow.

role.description: Role of the agent in the flow.

variant.description: Flow variant that the agent runs.

threadId.description: DIDComm thread identifier of the flow.

connectionId.description: Identifier of the DIDComm connection of the flow.

walletAgentParticipantId.description: Participant identifier of the wallet agent of this agent.

applicantParticipantId.description: Participant identifier of the applicant entry being onboarded.

validatorParticipantId.description: Participant identifier of the validator entry the applicant is onboarding under.

schemaId.description: Credential schema identifier of the flow.

claims.description: Credential claims that the applicant submitted.

oobLink.description: The outstanding oob-link, when one exists. Cleared on every transition out of OOB_PENDING. An expired link stays on the record until then and pendingAction reports it.

expiresAt.description: expires_time of the message, when the sender set one.

at.description: When the agent sent or received the message.

messages.description: Human-readable messages of the flow, in order. A validator lists what it sent, an applicant what it received.

text.description: Absent for a validating sent without a comment.

pendingAction.description: The party that must act for the flow to progress.

validation.description: Validation decision of an Onboarding Process flow, set by validateFlow.

issuance.description: Outcome of the transaction that anchors the issued credential.

credentialExchangeRecordId.description: Identifier of the credential exchange of the offered credential.

subprotocolThid.description: DIDComm thread identifier of the subprotocol in flight.

errorMessage.description: Message of the error that stopped the flow.

createdAt.description: Time when the agent created the flow.

updatedAt.description: Time when the agent last changed the flow.

lastEventAt.description: Time of the last event of the flow.

nextCursor.description: Cursor of the next page. The agent sets it to null on the last page.
